name: Cryogenic impact grinding of cartilage tissue for total-RNA extraction in a SPEX large Freezer/Mill (vials immersed in liquid nitrogen, about -196 °C)
plain_name: Grind frozen cartilage into powder for RNA extraction
description: Cartilage samples sealed in grinding vials with a magnetically driven impactor are pre-cooled and pulverized while immersed in liquid nitrogen (held at about -196 °C), up to four samples at once with the multi-vial adapter, keeping tissue far below -80 °C so RNA is not degraded.
keywords: Grind frozen cartilage into powder for RNA extraction

sources.citation: SPEX SamplePrep 14th Edition Handbook: Freezer/Mill section and application notes (SP002, SP005)

requirements.rationale: Samples are held at about -196 °C (77.15 K) in the liquid-nitrogen bath during pre-cooling and grinding.
Tissue for RNA or protein extraction must stay at -80 °C or colder throughout.
Grinding vials are immersed in liquid nitrogen throughout the grinding cycle.
